title: Topological realization of compact Markov-chain limits
statement: For the measure-theoretic limit transition densities $p_\infty(x,y,t)$ arising from sequences of finite reversible Markov chains, construct a natural topology—such as one induced by an integrated $L^2$ transition-density distance—that makes the state space complete and separable and the limit Markov process Feller.

research_summary: Partial progress. Towsner (2014, arXiv:1404.3815) provides the measure-theoretic limit of transition densities, and Landim (2015, arXiv:1310.3646) provides a path-space topology for Markov-chain limits handling instantaneous states. However, Aldous's specific requested object—a natural state-space topology (e.g., from an integrated $L^2$ transition-density distance) making the state space complete and separable and the limit Markov process Feller—is not established in the literature.
